chunks: The buyer of real estate is granted sustenance, and the seller of real estate is blotted out.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بَائِعُ: the one who sells or seller
key_terms.مَرْزُوقٌ: granted sustenance or blessed with provision
key_terms.مَمْحُوقٌ: one whose blessing or wealth is effaced
key_terms.مُشْتَرِي: the one who buys or purchaser

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about buying and selling real estate?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام contrasts the outcomes of acquiring and selling real estate, presenting purchase as linked with sustenance and sale as linked with diminishment. The hadith belongs to teachings on livelihood and wealth, and it emphasizes the moral and practical significance of preserving stable property.
